messages:
sarah: Quick heads-up — PR #13422 is passing locally but CI is consistently failing the matrix-e2e (windows) shard. The failures look flaky and only started after the dependency bump. I need a rebase slot before the Friday deploy freeze (18:00 UTC) or this will miss the release. Can someone with merge perms help prioritize a rerun/rebase?

alex: @sarah can you paste the failing test log? If it's just flaky we can try a single rerun, otherwise request a rebase slot. :eyes: 

sarah: pasted a short excerpt below — the full log is long but recurring stack trace: 
```
AssertionError: expected element to be visible
 at test/window-integration.test.js:87:14
 Received: Element detached from DOM
```

Also command to reproduce locally: 
```
CI_TEST_SHARD=windows npm run test:matrix -- --grep "window-integration"
```

taylor: I can try kicking a rerun now. If CI backs up because of the large queue, we might need to ask infra for a rebase slot. Friday freeze is tight.

ci-bot: CI rerun requested by taylor for PR #13422 — queued (position 8). Estimated start ~12m.

ben: If rerun still flakes, I'd suggest a quick rebase onto main, the bump fixed a timing issue in other repos. I can take the rebase if you want, @sarah. Rebase + single rerun should be fast. :+1: 

sarah: Thanks @ben — if you can rebase that'd be great. I want to avoid asking product to slip the freeze window.

alex: FYI ops scheduled a deploy-freeze for Fri 18:00-22:00 UTC in case anyone needs to plan. If rebase lands before 17:30 we should be OK. 

ci-bot: Rerun started for PR #13422 — running matrix-e2e/windows (shard 3).

ci-bot: matrix-e2e/windows (shard 3) PASSED. All checks green — rerun completed.

sarah: Awesome — merging now. Thanks @taylor for the rerun and @ben for offering the rebase. Will follow up if anything odd shows in canary. :rocket:
